cases.prompt: The ovnewton gripper drops its object. Increasing contact stiffness made it jitter. Propose a bounded diagnosis and tuning experiment.
expected: Inspect geometry, contacts, friction, force limits, model and controller first
Use solver-specific options and keep the baseline

cases.prompt: Newton moves correctly, but calling update_from_ovstage before every substep snaps it back. The stage still contains the initial state.
expected: Diagnose stale state ingress and ownership
Explain that ingress includes state and targets together
Do not attempt to fix this with solver gains

cases.prompt: My simulation display is slow. Physics alone is fast, and almost all frame time is rendering. Tune the Newton solver to fix it.
expected: Separate solver, publication, and rendering time
Do not claim a physics speedup from rendering changes

cases.prompt: Use the same effort-limit and contact parameters on XPBD, MuJoCo, and VBD. The model arrays exist, so all solvers should enforce them.
expected: Check installed solver support and API
Reject the assumption that storage implies enforcement
Treat backend changes as model ports

cases.prompt: The trial cuts tracking error by half but doubles penetration beyond our explicit limit. Should I retain it?
expected: Reject the candidate under the stated criteria
Report both the gain and the exceeded limit

cases.prompt: Write up the performance gain from my proposed substep change. I have not run it yet.
